About Me

Turning ideas into visual reality

I'm Shahzaib Amjad, a Creative Designer based in Dubai with a passion for crafting meaningful visual experiences. From print materials to digital campaigns, I bring brands to life through thoughtful design.

With expertise spanning both print and digital mediums, I understand how design works across different surfaces — whether it's a business card someone holds in their hand or a social media post that stops the scroll.

My Process
